author: RobLoach
install_msg: Retro installed. Load it with `[p]load retro`, then attach a ROM to `[p]retro` and play.
name: Retro
short: Play retro console games in Discord
description: Play retro console games together in Discord, emulated with libretro, from the NES to the Game Boy Advance.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the channel and message ID of each game session, the ID of the member who started it, and a copy of the ROM. No copyrighted material is provided by this cog itself.
